name: Jiribam Town
description: Jiribam is the headquarters of Jiribam district and the westernmost town of Manipur, serving as the western gateway bordering Assam on the Jiri River.
facts: Known as the Western Gate of Manipur
First railway station in the state is located here
Lies on the bank of the Jiri River near its confluence with the Barak
District formed in 2016 from Imphal East

name: Kangpokpi Town
description: Headquarters of Kangpokpi district and Sadar Hills Autonomous District Council, a hill town at about 1000-1220 m elevation along NH-2, serving as a gateway to the hills with tribal markets and cool climate.
facts: District formed in December 2016 from former Senapati Sadar Hills areas
Population around 7476 as per 2011 census
Elevation approximately 1000-1220 metres
Connected by National Highway 2 to Imphal and Dimapur

name: Mount Koubru
description: Sacred peak in the Koubru range, abode of Lainingthou Koubru and goddess Kounu in Meitei mythology, popular for pilgrimage and trekking with stone formations resembling Meitei alphabets at the summit.
facts: Elevation around 2131-2562 metres depending on source
Located in Saitu-Gamphazol subdivision of Kangpokpi
Saparmeina town lies at the base
Major pilgrimage site for Meitei community

name: Sadu Chiru Waterfall
description: Three-tiered waterfall also known as Leimaram Falls in Bungte Chiru area, cascading through lush forest with pools, accessible by short trek from the road, popular picnic and photography spot about 25 km from Imphal.
facts: Also called Leimaram Waterfall
Located in Bungte Chiru sub-division of Kangpokpi
First fall drops about 30 metres
Best visited post-monsoon for full flow

name: Singda Dam
description: Multi-purpose earthen dam on the Singda River completed in 1995, creating a scenic reservoir for irrigation, water supply and small hydropower, surrounded by hills and popular for picnics and views.
facts: Located in Singda village, Kangchup Geljang sub-division
Height about 60 metres, length 490 metres
Supplies water to Imphal and irrigates thousands of hectares
Coordinates 24°52'30" N, 93°48'24" E

name: Thangal Surung Eco Park
description: Eco-tourism complex at the birthplace of General Thangal, featuring memorial statues, parks and historical significance related to the Anglo-Manipur War of 1891, listed by Manipur Tourism as a recreational site.
facts: Birthplace of renowned General Thangal
About 33 km from Imphal
Also known as General Thangal Ecological Park
Host to community and commemorative events

name: Motbung Town
description: Large town in Saitu-Gamphazol subdivision known for local markets, community life, Presidency College and as a base for exploring surrounding hills and tribal culture.
facts: Population around 3601 as per 2011 census
Located in Saitu-Gamphazol sub-division
About 26-31 km from Imphal
Has primary health centre and educational institutions

name: Keithelmanbi Village
description: Large Thadou tribal village and military colony near Kangpokpi HQ, known for community life, river picnic spots, angling and as one of the bigger settlements in the district.
facts: Population over 4000
About 5 km from Kangpokpi town
Primarily Thadou tribe settlement
Has community halls and churches
